items.title: Nestle India Q1 Results: Net profit surges 48% YoY to Rs 975 crore; revenue rises 25%
items.description: Nestle India Q1 Results: The company’s revenue from operations for the quarter under review stood at Rs 6,378 crore, marking a 25% year-on-year (YoY) increase from Rs 5,096 crore, Nestle said in a regulatory filing.

items.title: Adani Power Q1 Results: Profit jumps 42% YoY to Rs 4,806 cr; co approves Rs 15,000 cr fundraise
items.description: Adani Power Q1 Results: ​​The company's board has approved a fundraising of Rs 15,000 crore through the issue of equity shares via QIP or other means.

items.title: HFCL Q1 results: Firm swings to black, net profit at Rs 246 crore, revenue soars 120% YoY
items.description: HFCL reported a sharp turnaround in Q1FY27, posting a net profit of Rs 246 crore against a year-ago loss as revenue more than doubled. Strong export growth, record order book, expanding AI infrastructure investments and capacity expansion supported robust earnings and strengthened the company's long-term growth outlook.

items.title: BPCL Q1 Results: Co reports loss of Rs 3,962 crore but revenue rises 23% YoY
items.description: BPCL reported a standalone loss of Rs 3,962 crore in the first quarter. Revenue from operations increased 23% year-on-year to Rs 1.59 lakh crore. Total expenses rose sharply to Rs 1.66 lakh crore from Rs 1.22 lakh crore a year earlier. The rise in expenses was led by higher cost of materials consumed. Refinery throughput stood at 10.15 million metric tonnes during the period.

items.title: Eternal Q1 Results: Cons PAT skyrockets 268% YoY to Rs 92 crore; revenue zooms 182%
items.description: Eternal Q1 Results: Food delivery giant Eternal reported a 268% year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 92 crore for Q1 FY27, while revenue from operations surged 182% to Rs 20,211 crore, driven by strong business growth. On a sequential basis, however, net profit fell 47% from the previous quarter, even as revenue rose 17%, reflecting mixed quarterly performance.

items.title: Adani Green Q1 Results: Profit jumps 19% YoY to Rs 845 crore; revenue up 16%
items.description: Adani Green Q1 Results: Adani Green reported a 19% year-on-year profit increase in the first quarter. Revenue from operations grew sixteen percent, driven by capacity expansion and strong performance. The company's operational capacity rose twenty-seven percent to over twenty gigawatts. Energy sales increased thirty percent, aided by fresh greenfield capacity additions. Adani Green is progressing on its thirty gigawatt renewable energy plant at Khavda.
